extraction_notes: Only SI experimental CO2-hydrogenation performance data were extracted. SI Figure S1 appears to duplicate the malachite-derived CuOx reference catalyst performance that is tabulated exactly in SI Table S1, so SI Table S1 values were used. SI Figure S2 contains grouped bar plots for pretreatment conditions, but the plotted bars are too small/dense to read reliable numerical values beyond rough visual estimates; these plot-only values were not extracted. Characterisation-only SI figures/tables were excluded.
